note: Town of Coronation campground on the Coronation Dam reservoir, beside the town's rodeo grounds, with newly built washrooms, group camping areas, a new playground and a camp kitchen to rent. The reservoir holds rainbow trout and northern pike and has a launch for small fishing boats (12-volt electric motors only). --Claude
summary: Town page (in a browser; curl was refused) and Campspot read. Confirmed C$35 (30-amp full hookup) and C$40 (50-amp pull-through) plus the C$5 booking fee, 50 sites, showers, dump, phone, town-run. Season written from the town bylaw: May 1 - Sep 30. Wrote max length 83 ft. Lakefront holds for a row of about nine pads at the north end only. Google 4.5 (53), Campspot 4.7 (45).
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront; holds for one row only): on Esri imagery (0.24 m/px) a row of about nine back-in pads at the north end of the reservoir (around 52.1068,-111.4500) ends 15-20 m from the water, with RVs parked 25-35 m from it, on open ground with no trees; a gravel shore road runs between the pad ends and the bank. The main loops by the pin are 60-170 m east of the shore, across the same road and a strip of planted trees, beside the rodeo track. The town says 'Situated along the stunning Coronation Dam'; Campspot's own text says 'the nearby reservoir' and tags no site waterfront. If lakefront is kept it needs the caveat that only the north-end row (about nine sites; site numbers not identified - the site map was not read) is on the water; otherwise lakeview.

SEASON vs CAMPSPOT: the bylaw sets May 1 - September 30, yet Campspot quoted the 30-amp sites as available for one night from 2027-04-27 and from 2027-10-05 (C$35 + C$5). The stored fees note says Campspot offered no sites in October 2026. The bylaw dates are written; the engine's shoulder dates are unexplained.

FEES (stored, confirmed, not rewritten): town page: 'fully serviced sites with water, 30 amp power and sewer come in at $35 per night ... drive-through sites with 50 amp power service are available for just $40 per night'; unserviced/tent C$20. Campspot one night from 2027-06-08: C$35 and C$40 before the park's C$5 'Booking Fee', taxes C$0.00. Local government; no gateway within 40 km.
SITE COUNT: town page '50 premium camping sites'; Campspot's marketplace text 'a generous 52 sites for RV (full hook-ups) and tent camping'; Campspot's inventory lists 45 RV sites plus tent sites.

WEBSITE: the town's booking link is https://www.campspot.com/book/coronationdamcampground (the stored marketplace link also works). www.coronation.ca refuses plain fetches (403) but loads in a browser.

OPERATOR: Campspot legal name 'Town of Coronation, a Alberta Governmental Entity, d/b/a Coronation Dam Campground'; ownership local confirmed. The grounds are the 'Coronation Recreation Park Campground and Rodeo Grounds' in the bylaw.
RATINGS: Google 4.5 (53 reviews); Campspot 4.7 (45 verified ratings).
PIN: 52.10431,-111.44655 is at the main loops on Esri imagery; the north-end row is about 330 m north-west on the same grounds. No move.
